profile_text.body:
LinkedIn is a for-profit company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, United States. Its own site describes it as a place to manage your professional identity, build and engage with your professional network, and access knowledge, insights and opportunities. The site states that it has 1 billion members. Features it highlights include Open To Work, which lets members privately tell recruiters or publicly share that they are looking for new opportunities, messaging to people you know, and live videos, stories, and newsletters for following industry discussions.

The company's site presents itself primarily as a professional networking and identity service rather than as an AI product vendor, and no AI products are tracked for it. Its AI-adjacent presence in the record is an MCP server listed as ai.com.mcp/linkedin, described as exposing the LinkedIn API as MCP tools to retrieve profile data and publish content, powered by HAPI MCP.

On the legal side, the record shows 281 cases in California. No lawsuits are otherwise listed, and no SEC or patent facts are held.
